overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a strong and highly targeted academic and professional social media presence across Mastodon, LinkedIn, and Bluesky, totaling 3,580 followers. His content successfully engages researchers and data scientists, focusing on computational social science, disinformation, and coordinated inauthentic behavior. While LinkedIn provides the highest absolute reach, Bluesky demonstrates the strongest community resonance and engagement rate per follower, driven by active sharing of papers and academic opportunities.

contentThemes.description: Updates on software development (CooRnet v2.0) and methodology for detecting coordinated link sharing and influence campaigns.
Recruitment posts for postdoctoral researchers and PhD opportunities in computational social science.
Announcements regarding research grants, new publications, and upcoming presentations at specialized conferences like DisinfoConf2025.

recommendations: Capitalize on Bluesky's high engagement rate by using it for early-stage research discussions, quick calls-to-action, and community-driven Q&A.
Utilize LinkedIn primarily as a professional hub for high-impact milestones such as research grants, publications, and recruitment, utilizing its larger follower base for maximum reach.
Increase posting frequency on Mastodon with highly technical updates, open-source tool documentation, and code releases to appeal to its tech-savvy audience.

platformInsights.bluesky: The platform yields the highest average engagement rate (6.14%), driven by an active network that frequently reposts academic opportunities and newly published research.
platformInsights.mastodon: Serves as a specialized tech/academic node, showing steady engagement (4.55% average) particularly for software updates like CooRnet, though with lower overall reach.
platformInsights.linkedin: Generates the highest absolute engagement (likes and comments) with a solid 4.87% average engagement rate, proving highly effective for professional announcements, funding success, and job hiring.
